method: Percentile bootstrap; resample start-plan clusters within the preassigned 78/77 scenario groups. Preserve paired v11 and original descent data for each start. Historical original straight data have an independent seed plan and are resampled independently.
estimator: Half of the mean straight-flight FPS plus half of mean descent-flight FPS. Each flight equally weighted within scenario; retain early ends; no outlier trimming.
comparisons: v12 versus full published v11 reference
v12 versus v11 restricted to the same 155 assigned starts and scenarios
